fusions.name: Butt to Bedrock
fusions.desc: Drives the foot of the staff into the ground. The shock deals 13 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and stuns each for 1 second.

fusions.name: Pry the Fault
fusions.desc: Sets the foot of the staff into a crack in the target's guard and levers it wide. It deals 28 damage, ignores armour and leaves the target 25% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Rooted Menhir
fusions.desc: Stone closes around the grounded staff and your legs. Your armour rises by 30% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Wayside Cairn
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stone is set at the foot of the staff and a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (42% at full) before your health takes damage. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
